description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages of various model configurations evaluated across two distinct datasets, labeled "PHEME" and "PolitiFact". The horizontal axis displays the categories, which are divided into two main panels corresponding to the datasets, separated by a vertical dashed line. Within each panel, six model configurations are listed in a consistent order with slightly rotated labels: "Ours", "w/o comments", "w/o text", "w/o select", "w/o emotion", and "w/o cognition". The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Accuracy (%)", utilizing a linear scale that ranges from 75.0 to 95.0, with tick marks and corresponding horizontal dashed grid lines at regular intervals of 2.5. The chart features grouped vertical bars, where each group of six adjacent bars corresponds to a dataset. Each configuration is represented by a specific color: "Ours" is dark red, "w/o comments" is orange, "w/o text" is light yellow, "w/o select" is light blue, "w/o emotion" is medium blue, and "w/o cognition" is dark blue. The bars are not sorted by height but follow the predefined categorical order, and each bar is visually emphasized with a thin black outline and an exact numerical value annotated in bold text directly above it. In the PHEME group, the values are 89.84 for "Ours" (the tallest bar in this group), 86.82 for "w/o comments", 80.10 for "w/o text" (the shortest bar in this group), 88.80 for "w/o select", 87.34 for "w/o emotion", and 87.17 for "w/o cognition". In the PolitiFact group, the values are 90.57 for "Ours" (the tallest bar overall), 85.85 for "w/o comments", 83.02 for "w/o text" (the shortest bar in this group), 89.62 for "w/o select", 84.91 for "w/o emotion", and 87.74 for "w/o cognition".
